prompt.ja: いま聞いた音の流れに最も近い説明を一つ選ぶ。判断できなければ「判別できない」を選ぶ。好みや音のよさを答える課題ではない。
prompt.en: Choose the description closest to the musical flow you just heard, or choose cannot tell. This question asks about the heard relation, not preference or sound quality.

prefix_instruction.ja: 再生が止まる位置は実験上の区切りであり、曲の終わりを意味しない。止まる前に実際に聞こえた音について答える。
prefix_instruction.en: Playback stops are experimental cuts, not necessarily musical endings. Judge the material actually heard before the cut.

descriptions.en: The parts pass a gesture through overlapping releases
descriptions.ja: 音の担い手が余韻を重ねながら、一つの身振りを受け渡す

descriptions.en: The parts stop and start together
descriptions.ja: 音の担い手が一緒に止まり、一緒に鳴り始める

descriptions.en: Long sounds overlap without a shared gesture
descriptions.ja: 長い音が重なるが、共通する身振りは聞こえない

tasks.directional_contrast: context_on minus context_off in intended-description choice rate
tasks.denominator: all assigned responses in that arm, including cannot_tell, missing and invalid; report each separately

descriptions.en: The parts keep distinct positions around an anticipated recurrence
descriptions.ja: 繰り返しを予期しながら、音の担い手がそれぞれ違う位置で鳴る

descriptions.en: The parts converge on the same repeated onset
descriptions.ja: 音の担い手が同じ繰り返しの発音時刻へ揃っていく

descriptions.en: Timing changes without a recurring reference
descriptions.ja: 繰り返しの参照がないまま、鳴る時刻が変わる

tasks.directional_contrast: context_on minus context_off in intended-description choice rate

descriptions.ja: 音の担い手が異なる時間的位置を保ち、入り方が噛み合う

descriptions.en: Parts align their entries on the same timing position
descriptions.ja: 音の担い手が同じ時間的位置に入り方を揃える

descriptions.en: Parts shift their entries without a persistent timing relation
descriptions.ja: 持続する時間的関係がないまま、音の担い手が入り方を変える

tasks.directional_contrast: context_on minus context_off in intended-description choice rate

descriptions.en: Earlier material returns with a changed realization
descriptions.ja: 以前の素材が、形を変えて戻ってくる

descriptions.en: Earlier material repeats without a heard transformation
descriptions.ja: 以前の素材が、聞き取れる変化なしに繰り返される

descriptions.en: Material arrives without a heard return
descriptions.ja: 戻ってきたとは聞こえない素材が現れる

descriptions.en: The local ending resolves an earlier expectation
descriptions.ja: この終わり方が、それ以前からの期待を解決する

descriptions.en: The local ending interrupts an ongoing expectation
descriptions.ja: この終わり方が、続いていた期待を途中で断ち切る

descriptions.en: The local ending continues the ongoing expectation
descriptions.ja: この終わり方の先にも、それまでの期待が続く

tasks.directional_contrast: context_on minus context_off in intended-description choice rate
tasks.denominator: all assigned responses in that arm, including cannot_tell, missing and invalid; report each separately

descriptions.en: A returning section brings back an earlier way of participating
descriptions.ja: 以前の区間が戻り、それ以前の音の参加の仕方も戻る

descriptions.en: A new section brings a different way of participating
descriptions.ja: 新しい区間になり、音の参加の仕方も変わる

descriptions.en: The parts continue their current way through the change
descriptions.ja: 区間が変わっても、それまでの音の参加の仕方が続く

tasks.directional_contrast: context_on minus context_off in intended-description choice rate

descriptions.en: Earlier returns alter later participation across the piece
descriptions.ja: 曲の中で以前の素材が戻ると、その後の音の参加の仕方も変わる

descriptions.en: The same local response recurs regardless of the earlier course
descriptions.ja: それ以前の流れにかかわらず、同じ局所的な応答が繰り返される

descriptions.en: Participation changes without a heard relation to earlier material
descriptions.ja: 以前の素材との関係が聞こえないまま、音の参加の仕方が変わる

assignment.arm: randomly assign only one member of a matched on/off pair per listener; balance by passage and participant
assignment.description_order: uniform random permutation of the three descriptions per assigned trial; cannot_tell remains available
pair_preconditions: same candidate times for pressure-only comparison
context state intervention separated from identical-input on/off
preserve full preceding context for long-form trials
withheld_from_model: EOF as an inferred musical boundary

cohorts.validation_rule: fix N before recruitment, at least 48 and enough for >=80% simulated joint power at an on/off difference of 0.15; no interim-result stopping
cohorts.validation_exclusions: independent listeners not used in fitting or calibration
cohorts.correspondence_recognition_cohorts: disjoint; one prefix per source family per listener

pilot.denominator: all assignments; do not exclude failed comprehension checks to inflate rate
pilot.failure: revise wording/instructions on development and use a new cohort; do not relax criteria

joint_acceptance.rule_1: 95% passage/participant-clustered CI lower bound for intended_on-null must be >0
joint_acceptance.rule_2: intended_on-intended_off >=0.15 and its own 95% clustered CI lower bound >0
joint_acceptance.interval_method: two-way crossed bootstrap: independently resample participants and source families with replacement; use product multiplicities for each assigned cell; recompute per-arm rates each draw; percentile interval
joint_acceptance.empty_arm_draw: invalid analysis design; report and revise allocation before validation, never silently discard draws
joint_acceptance.power_method: development-based crossed participant/passage simulation including observed abstention; estimate probability both rules pass at 0.15 contrast; freeze final N and nuisance distributions before validation
joint_acceptance.author_acceptance: separate Gate 4; never inferred from Gate 3

required: all corresponding M0 numerical and synthetic gates
validated stimulus delivery and channel mapping
frozen sample-size simulation and recruitment count
